## Datasets

GEMMA supports open access to data. Measurement datasets from the project's
observation networks are archived in publicly accessible repositories and made
available under open licences.

**Weybourne Atmospheric Observatory**
Greenhouse gas measurements from the Weybourne Atmospheric Observatory are archived on
the [ICOS Carbon Portal](https://data.icos-cp.eu/portal/#%7B%22filterCategories%22%3A%7B%22project%22%3A%5B%22icos%22%5D%2C%22level%22%3A%5B1%2C2%5D%2C%22stationclass%22%3A%5B%22ICOS%22%5D%2C%22station%22%3A%5B%22iAS_WAO%22%5D%7D%7D).

**UK DECC and GEMMA networks**
Long-term ground-based greenhouse gas and ozone-depleting substance measurements from
the GEMMA and DECC networks are archived at the
[Centre for Environmental Data Analysis (CEDA)](https://data.ceda.ac.uk/badc/uk-decc-network/data).

## Software and tools

GEMMA has supported the development of the following open-source software, in
collaboration with other projects. All are hosted by the
[OpenGHG organisation on GitHub](https://github.com/openghg) and free to use.

**OpenGHG**
A platform for storing, sharing and analysing greenhouse gas data, including
atmospheric measurements, emissions maps and model outputs. It brings these
datasets into a common format so that researchers can work with them together.
[Code](https://github.com/openghg/openghg) ·
[Website](https://www.openghg.org) ·
[Documentation](https://docs.openghg.org/)

**OpenGHG Inversions**
Software for atmospheric inversion: estimating where greenhouse gases are emitted,
and how much, from measured concentrations. It links the data handling in OpenGHG
with the inverse models developed by the Atmospheric Chemistry Research Group at the
University of Bristol.
[Code](https://github.com/openghg/openghg_inversions) ·
[Documentation](https://openghg.github.io/openghg_inversions/) ·
[Archived release (Zenodo)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10650595)

**FLUXIE (Flux Intercomparison Environment)**
Tools for comparing emissions estimates produced by different inverse models,
developed with the PARIS project.
[Code](https://github.com/openghg/fluxie) ·
[Archived release (Zenodo)](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19184134)
